title: 第9章【冥婚】喜庆的房间
slug: 诡异副本勇敢者的游戏
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

满墙贴上红色的“囍”字，让整个房间透露出一股说不出的诡异，明明是喜庆的装饰，却在这种环境下让人脊背发凉。

顾原在房间中站了片刻，随即强压下心中的不适，在房间中翻找起来。

方清的房间并不大，里面的东西也很少，一张木床，一个衣柜还有一个梳妆台，外加几张凳子基本上就是她全部的家具。

他先从梳妆台翻起。

抽屉里只有一些零碎的发卡、梳子和一面缺了角的铜镜，没有值得注意的东西。

接着是衣柜，但衣柜里挂着几件朴素的衣裳，叠得整整齐齐，最底层压着一块红布，顾原掀开红布，底下是一个老式的木质相框。

而令感到奇怪的是，相框上面出现很多裂痕，就连玻璃也都碎成好几片。

顾原摇摇头，没有再关注相框本身，而是看向照片。

照片中，方清穿着一身红色嫁衣，但脸上却没有半分喜色，反倒是呈现着疲惫不堪的样子，甚至她的脸颊都已经凹陷进去，嘴唇也没有一点血色，看上去像是长期的营养不良。

顾原看到这一幕并不意外，因为她家本就是一个极度重男轻女的家庭，因为李小娥没生下一个男孩，所以她老公便将所有的怒气发向她，甚至村里也说李小娥是一个不会下蛋的老母鸡。

而这一切，最终也回到了方清的身上。

李小娥时常骂方清，甚至动手打她，有事也不给她吃饭，所以之前在顾原的印象中，方清身上经常出现青一块紫一块的痕迹，并且身材瘦小，像是一阵风都能刮跑一样。

顾原看到这一幕除了有些心疼外，更多的是愤怒，因为方清是自己的青梅竹马，现在却搞成了这副样子，不由得叹了口气。

顾原最终还是选择重新用红布将相框盖上放了起来。

在桌子的正下方，一个东西吸引到了顾原的注意，那是一双红色的绣花鞋，上面用金色的线勾出了一个“囍”字。

看到那双绣花鞋的瞬间，顾原总觉得一股凉意袭来，随后准备捡起来。

顾原伸手去拿，指尖刚触到鞋面，一股刺骨的寒意便顺着手指蹿上来，直冲脑门，他猛地哆嗦了一下，但还是把鞋拿了出来。

绣花鞋在他掌心中微微发烫，又微微发凉，两种矛盾的感觉交替出现，让他觉得手里的不像是鞋，更像是一个活物。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The red characters "囍" are plastered all over the wall, giving the whole room an indescribable weirdness. It is obviously a festive decoration, but in this environment, it makes people feel chills down their spines.

Gu Yuan stood in the room for a moment, then suppressed the discomfort in his heart and started rummaging around the room.

Fang Qing's room was not big, and there were very few things in it. A wooden bed, a wardrobe, a dressing table, and a few stools were basically all her furniture.

He started from the dressing table.

There were only some scattered hairpins, combs and a bronze mirror with a corner missing in the drawer, nothing of note.

Next was the wardrobe, but there were a few simple clothes hanging in the wardrobe, neatly folded, and a red cloth was pressed on the bottom layer. Gu Yuan opened the red cloth and found an old-fashioned wooden photo frame underneath.

What is strange is that there are many cracks on the photo frame, and even the glass is broken into several pieces.

Gu Yuan shook his head and no longer paid attention to the photo frame itself, but looked at the photo.

In the photo, Fang Qing was wearing a red wedding dress, but her face was not happy at all. Instead, she looked exhausted. Her cheeks were even sunken, and her lips had no color at all. She looked like she had suffered from chronic malnutrition.

Gu Yuan was not surprised to see this scene, because her family was originally an extremely patriarchal family. Because Li Xiaoe did not give birth to a boy, her husband turned all his anger on her. Even the village said that Li Xiaoe was an old hen that could not lay eggs.

And all of this finally came back to Fang Qing.

Li Xiao'e often scolded Fang Qing, even hit her, and refused to feed her when something happened. Therefore, in Gu Yuan's previous impression, Fang Qing often had bruises and bruises on her body, and she was so thin that she could be blown away by a gust of wind.

Gu Yuan was not only a little distressed when he saw this scene, but also more angry, because Fang Qing was his childhood sweetheart, but now he was like this, and he couldn't help but sigh.

Gu Yuan finally chose to cover the photo frame with red cloth and put it up.

Right under the table, something caught Gu Yuan's attention. It was a pair of red embroidered shoes with the word "囍" outlined in gold thread.

The moment he saw the embroidered shoes, Gu Yuan felt a chill coming over him, and then he was about to pick them up.

Gu Yuan stretched out his hand to take it. As soon as his fingertips touched the upper of the shoe, a biting chill rushed up along his fingers and went straight to his forehead. He shivered violently, but still took out the shoe.

The embroidered shoes were slightly hot and slightly cold in his palms. The two contradictory feelings alternated, making him feel that the shoes in his hands were more like a living thing than shoes.
